basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I've been diving deep into the world of video games for over two decades, with a particular fondness for retro and Yakuza games. When I'm not gaming, I'm probably working as a software developer for a mid-sized tech firm. Married to a fellow gamer, and we often co-op on weekends. Typically online during late evenings, especially on weekends. Not a fan of overly commercialized games or microtransactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge in both gaming and software development. Grew up playing classic consoles, which led to a deep appreciation and understanding of game mechanics and design. Holds a degree in Computer Science and has been working in the tech industry for over 10 years. Self-taught in blockchain technology, recently exploring Ethereum Classic.
